title: Walk through any room, floor or project in a looping video
dek: The build story in under a minute: a camera that plans its own shots, a plan that travels with the clip, and a clear view at eye level.

scenes.label: Build notes
scenes.headline: Walk through any room, floor or project in a looping video

scenes.label: The problem
lines: Your customers need to see the plan.
They shouldn't have to *steer a 3D view* to do it.

scenes.label: 01 · A camera that plans its own shots
scenes.headline: The room decides the shots.
scenes.sub: Orbit, a glide to eye level, the plan from above, then back to the first frame, so it loops.
scenes.say: A real room export, at 1.5× speed

scenes.label: 02 · The plan in the corner
scenes.headline: The plan in the corner goes where the clip goes.
scenes.sub: It's drawn into every frame, so it's in the download and the chat preview too.

regions.say: The floor's plan, in every frame
Where the camera stands, and what it sees

scenes.label: 03 · Floors and projects
scenes.headline: The same shots, room after room.
scenes.sub: A floor tour runs 60 s at most, a project 90 s. Small rooms drop out before visits get rushed.

scenes.label: 04 · Nothing in the way
scenes.headline: Anything in the way fades out.
scenes.sub: A lamp in the corner fades as the camera comes down, and returns as it rises.

scenes.label: Try it
scenes.headline: Open a room and export its video.
scenes.foot: On a floor, choose Video. On a project, Export, then Walkthrough video.
